submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 provides the highest signal efficiency (92.8%) at the 8 kHz allocated trigger rate, outperforming the other candidates across all thresholds within the allowed 20–60 GeV range. All requirements are satisfied: Algorithm-L1 is a candidate algorithm, deployable in Level-1 hardware according to resource budgets, and the threshold is within the required range. This matches both new and historic simulation results.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 is listed among the candidate algorithms.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: All three candidate algorithms, including Algorithm-L1, fit within the FPGA resource budget.
The selected threshold is 35 GeV, within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 at 35 GeV yields 92.8% signal efficiency, the highest among all candidates for the 8 kHz allocated rate.
